blocks.text: The Ultimate Dermaplaning Experience At Face Skin & Body Bar
blocks.html: The Ultimate Dermaplaning Experience At Face Skin & Body Bar

At Face Skin & Body Bar in Calgary, we understand that truly healthy and luminous skin begins with a smooth, refined canvas. That’s why our dermaplaning facial is one of our most sought-after facial treatments, consistently delivering a vibrant complexion that our clients adore. If you're looking to brighten your complexion, enhance product absorption, and achieve a flawless makeup application, our expert dermaplaning treatment offers a non-invasive yet highly effective solution. Step into a world where your skin feels incredibly soft and looks visibly brighter.

blocks.html: A dermaplaning facial is a sophisticated, non-invasive cosmetic procedure that involves the meticulous manual exfoliation of the outermost layer of the epidermis. Utilizing a sterile, surgical-grade blade, our highly trained practitioners gently glide the tool across the skin's surface. This precise technique effectively removes accumulated dead skin cells and the fine, wispy vellus hair—commonly known as "peach fuzz"—that can dull the complexion and trap debris.

Unlike harsh abrasive scrubs, our dermaplaning treatment provides a gentle yet incredibly effective form of physical exfoliation. By carefully scraping away these superficial layers of dead skin, the procedure reveals the fresh, healthy skin underneath. This process immediately leaves your skin feeling incredibly smooth to the touch and looking exceptionally vibrant and glowing. It's a cornerstone of modern skin rejuvenation, offering instant gratification with lasting benefits.
The advantages of incorporating a dermaplaning facial into your skin care routine are numerous and impactful, making it an incredibly popular choice for a wide range of skin concerns:

items: Instant Radiance and Smoothness: By removing dulling dead skin cells and peach fuzz, dermaplaning immediately reveals brighter, more luminous skin. The surface becomes incredibly smooth, allowing light to reflect evenly and creating a youthful glow.

Enhanced Product Absorption: With the barrier of dead skin cells and vellus hair removed, your serums, moisturizers, and other topical skin care products can penetrate much deeper into the skin. This significantly boosts their efficacy, allowing active ingredients to work more effectively.

Softened Appearance of Fine Lines and Wrinkles: While not a permanent solution for deep wrinkles, the removal of layers of dead skin on the surface helps to soften the appearance of fine lines and superficial wrinkles, making them less noticeable.

Flawless Makeup Application: The removal of peach fuzz and uneven skin texture creates an impeccably smooth canvas. Makeup glides on seamlessly, blends effortlessly, and appears more natural and airbrushed, making it the perfect skin treatment before special events.
Improved Skin Texture: Regular dermaplaning treatment contributes to a more refined and uniform skin texture, reducing the appearance of minor irregularities.
Non-Invasive and Minimal Downtime: As a gentle, manual exfoliation, dermaplaning requires virtually no downtime, making it an ideal "lunchtime" procedure for busy schedules.
Safe for Many Skin Types: Dermaplaning is generally safe and effective for a wide range of skin types.

blocks.html: A dermaplaning facial is suitable for most skin types and tones, offering a versatile solution for numerous aesthetic goals. It's particularly ideal for individuals who wish to:

items: Achieve an immediate boost in skin radiance and smoothness
Enhance the effectiveness of their topical skin care products
Reduce the appearance of fine lines and superficial wrinkles
Create a perfectly smooth canvas for makeup application
Remove bothersome peach fuzz (vellus hair) that can make skin look dull
Exfoliate dead skin cells gently without harsh chemicals
Find a gentle exfoliation method for sensitive skin types

blocks.html: However, it is not recommended for individuals with active acne breakouts, open wounds, or highly sensitive skin conditions like rosacea flares. Our expert practitioners will conduct a thorough skin assessment during your consultation to determine if a dermaplaning treatment is the most appropriate and effective pathway to your desired outcomes.
Your dermaplaning facial at Face Skin & Body Bar is a relaxing and rejuvenating 75-minute experience. The process involves several key steps designed to maximize your comfort and results:

items: Thorough Cleansing: Your skin will be cleansed to remove all traces of makeup, oils, and environmental impurities, ensuring a clean and sterile canvas.

Dermaplaning Exfoliation: Using a sterile, surgical-grade blade, your practitioner will gently and expertly glide the tool across your skin at a precise angle. This careful technique manually exfoliates the surface, lifting away dead skin cells and peach fuzz (vellus hair). The process is comfortable and often described as a soft scraping sensation.

Intensive Recovery Hydrojelly Mask: Following the exfoliation, an Intensive Recovery Hydrojelly mask will be applied. This soothing and hydrating mask calms the skin, reduces any temporary redness, and infuses it with vital nutrients and hydration, enhancing the post-treatment glow.

LED Light Therapy: To further enhance skin rejuvenation and promote healing, a 15-minute session of LED Light Therapy will be administered. This gentle, non-invasive light treatment works at a cellular level to calm inflammation, stimulate collagen production, and accelerate the skin's recovery process.

blocks.html: A single dermaplaning treatment delivers immediate and remarkable benefits, leaving your skin exquisitely smooth and luminous. For optimal, sustained results and to maintain your radiant complexion, we typically recommend scheduling a dermaplaning facial every 4 to 6 weeks. This cadence aligns perfectly with your natural skin cell turnover cycle, ensuring consistent exfoliation, preventing the buildup of dead skin cells and bothersome peach fuzz, and keeping your skin consistently at its best.

This skin treatment is also highly recommended as a preparatory step before significant events such as weddings, important presentations, hot sunny vacations, anniversaries, or birthdays. It creates the perfect, flawlessly smooth canvas for makeup, ensuring you look and feel your absolute best on your special occasion.
Our dermaplaning treatment is primarily performed on the face. However, it can also be safely applied to the:

items: Neck
Décolleté
Back

blocks.html: These areas often show signs of sun damage and aging, and dermaplaning can significantly improve their texture and appearance.

Immediately following your dermaplaning treatment, you'll notice a remarkable difference: Your skin will feel incredibly soft, look exceptionally smooth, and possess a luminous, healthy glow. Makeup will glide on effortlessly, appearing more flawless than ever before. Over the days that follow, you'll continue to experience enhanced product absorption, allowing your favourite serums and moisturizers to deliver their benefits more effectively. The subtle softening of fine lines and overall improvement in skin texture contribute to a refreshed and revitalized appearance.
